metadata.title: Flux redistribution of central carbon metabolism for efficient production of L-tryptophan in Escherichia coli

reference.title: Flux redistribution of central carbon metabolism for efficient production of L-tryptophan in Escherichia coli

target.pathway: central carbon metabolism → shikimate pathway → aromatic amino acid biosynthesis

trigger.observation: 色氨酸产量停滞,尽管终端途径酶已充分表达。葡萄糖摄取和生物量仍在增加,说明瓶颈不在碳源摄取或生长,而在前体供应。
trigger.reasoning: 色氨酸的芳香环来自 shikimate 途径,而 shikimate 途径的前体 PEP(磷酸烯醇式丙酮酸)和 E4P(赤藓糖-4-磷酸)均来自中心碳代谢。终端酶过表达不增产=前体供应可能存在瓶颈。
trigger.source_location: Introduction / Results: titer plateau despite terminal enzyme overexpression

evidence.description: 终端酶过表达后色氨酸滴度不再线性增加,说明终端酶容量不是速率限制步骤。
evidence.source_location: Results: effect of terminal enzyme overexpression on titer

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: 终端酶过表达→滴度不增产是论文实测数据,属于硬证据。

alternatives.rejected_reason: 数据已表明终端酶不是瓶颈,继续加只会增加代谢负担

decision_chain.implementation_detail: 先诊断前体供应瓶颈,而非盲目增加终端酶——这本身是一个诊断步骤,尚未涉及具体基因改造

result.after: 确认瓶颈在前体供应(PEP/E4P)而非终端酶容量

decision_chain.rule: 终端途径酶已充分表达但滴度平台时,优先排查前体供应瓶颈而非继续增加终端酶——这避免了在非瓶颈点浪费代谢资源

target.pathway: 中心碳代谢—糖酵解—PEP 节点

trigger.observation: 色氨酸途径每分子产物消耗 1 分子 PEP + 1 分子 E4P。PEP 同时被 PTS 葡萄糖转运系统(每分子葡萄糖耗 1 PEP)和丙酮酸激酶(PykF)竞争消耗。E4P 来自磷酸戊糖途径(PPP)。
trigger.reasoning: 要提高 PEP 可用性,需要减少其竞争消耗。PtsG 介导的葡萄糖 PTS 转运每分子葡萄糖消耗 1 PEP;PykF 将 PEP 不可逆地转为丙酮酸。减少这两条竞争路线可释放 PEP 用于 shikimate 途径。
trigger.source_location: Known E. coli central carbon metabolism (textbook / EcoCyc)

evidence.description: PTS 系统每分子葡萄糖消耗 1 PEP 是化学计量事实(硬);PykF 催化的 PEP→pyruvate 不可逆(硬)。具体的敲除效果需要 FBA 模拟或用论文实测数据支撑。
evidence.source_location: EcoCyc: PTS transport stoichiometry; glycolysis pathway

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: PEP 化学计量是化学计量事实,属于硬证据。但具体的敲除效果预测(如敲 ptsG 后 PEP 增加多少)如果来自 OptKnock 等工具则标记为软证据——本条引用的是化学计量本身,归硬。

alternatives.approach: 过表达 PEP 合成酶(ppsA)
alternatives.rejected_reason: 增加合成的同时不减少消耗,效果不如直接阻断竞争消耗路线;且 ppsA 催化 pyruvate→PEP 需要 ATP,能量成本高

decision_chain.implementation_detail: 敲除 ptsG(PTS 葡萄糖转运蛋白),替换为 glf(非 PTS 葡萄糖 facilitator)+ glk(葡萄糖激酶),以节省 PEP;可选敲除或弱化 pykF 以减少 PEP→pyruvate 的通量泄漏

result.before: 每分子葡萄糖摄取消耗 1 PEP(PTS) + 糖酵解持续消耗 PEP
result.after: 非 PTS 摄取节省 PEP;pykF 弱化进一步保留 PEP

decision_chain.rule: 前体(PEP/E4P)供应不足时,优先阻断竞争消耗路线(KO PTS 组分、弱化丙酮酸激酶)而非仅增加合成——减少消耗比增加合成在化学计量上更直接

trigger.observation: PEP 和 E4P 可用性提升后,shikimate 途径的通量可能受限于入口酶 DAHP synthase(AroG)的容量或其自身的反馈调控(AroG 受苯丙氨酸反馈抑制,AroH 受色氨酸反馈抑制)。
trigger.reasoning: 前体供应解决后,下一步瓶颈可能转移到途径入口。同时需要:(1)确保 DAHP synthase 容量足够;(2)解除其自身的反馈抑制。

evidence.description: AroG 受 L-phenylalanine 反馈抑制,AroH 受 L-tryptophan 反馈抑制——均为已知调控机制。AroG 的同工酶 AroF 受酪氨酸调控,需根据目标产物选择合适的同工酶。

decision_chain.evidence_grading_rationale: DAHP synthase 同工酶的反馈调控是已知的、被验证的机制,归硬。

alternatives.approach: 直接过表达野生型 aroG
alternatives.rejected_reason: 如果仍有苯丙氨酸积累,AroG 会被反馈抑制——需要反馈抗性突变体(aroG-fbr)

alternatives.approach: AroG 和 AroH 同时过表达
alternatives.rejected_reason: 两者受不同产物反馈抑制,选择取决于主要目标产物(Trp→选 AroH-fbr)

decision_chain.implementation_detail: 过表达反馈抗性的 DAHP synthase(aroG-fbr 或 aroH-fbr),确保 shikimate 途径入口不被反馈抑制堵住

result.before: DAHP synthase 受反馈抑制+容量限制
result.after: 反馈抗性突变体释放入口通量

decision_chain.rule: 前体供应和途径入口是串联瓶颈:先解决前体(中心碳代谢),再解决入口(DAHP synthase 反馈抗性)——顺序不能反。入口酶存在多个同工酶受不同产物反馈抑制时,按目标产物选择对应的反馈抗性突变体。

engineering_actions.target: central carbon metabolism precursor supply (PEP, E4P)
engineering_actions.gene_or_pathway: central carbon metabolism (glycolysis / pentose phosphate pathway); specific gene targets are not specified in the problem summary available to this V1 knowledge base and require review of the primary text
engineering_actions.source: Xiong B. et al., 2021, Biotechnology and Bioengineering, DOI:10.1002/bit.27665
engineering_actions.rationale: the core finding is that precursor limitation must be diagnosed and central carbon flux rebalanced before overexpressing terminal pathway enzymes, otherwise enzyme overexpression is capped by precursor supply.
engineering_actions.expected_effect: increased PEP/E4P availability supporting higher shikimate-pathway flux
engineering_actions.risk: redirecting central carbon flux toward aromatic amino acid precursors may reduce flux available to biomass formation or other essential pathways, potentially affecting growth
validation: measure intracellular PEP/E4P pool sizes before and after the intervention
compare L-tryptophan titer/yield with and without central carbon flux redistribution

engineering_actions.target: terminal aromatic amino acid biosynthetic enzymes
engineering_actions.gene_or_pathway: terminal shikimate/tryptophan pathway enzymes; specific gene identities are not specified in the problem summary available to this V1 knowledge base
engineering_actions.source: Xiong B. et al., 2021, Biotechnology and Bioengineering, DOI:10.1002/bit.27665
engineering_actions.rationale: terminal enzyme overexpression remains a necessary step, but per the core rule it should follow precursor-supply analysis rather than be attempted first.
engineering_actions.expected_effect: additional flux increase once precursor limitation has been relieved
engineering_actions.risk: overexpressing terminal enzymes before addressing precursor supply adds metabolic burden without proportional titer gain
validation: compare titer improvement from terminal-enzyme overexpression alone versus combined with precursor/flux engineering

_engineering_actions_note: Kept verbatim from DDR schema v1 (not part of the teacher's v2 spec) because workflows/synbio_v1/modules/engineering.py - a separate, older demo pipeline distinct from harness/paper_extraction - still reads this exact key/shape. decision_chain above is the canonical v2 source; this array is a compat projection of the same underlying facts, not independently curated content.

engineering_problem.problem_statement: L-tryptophan production is limited by precursor supply and carbon flux imbalance rather than by terminal pathway enzyme capacity alone.
trigger_conditions: target product depends on aromatic amino acid (shikimate) pathway precursors
terminal biosynthetic enzymes are already expressed but titer remains limited
carbon flux distribution between competing central-metabolism pathways is imbalanced

observations: increasing terminal pathway enzyme expression alone does not proportionally raise L-tryptophan titer
aromatic amino acid biosynthesis draws on precursors (e.g. PEP, E4P) shared with central carbon metabolism
anthranilate synthase (TrpE) and trp operon expression are subject to feedback inhibition/attenuation by intracellular tryptophan - a regulatory mechanism independent of precursor supply
bottlenecks: imbalanced carbon flux distribution across central metabolism
feedback inhibition of anthranilate synthase (TrpE) and attenuation of the trp operon, independent of precursor supply
biological_diagnosis.mechanistic_explanation: The shikimate pathway that feeds aromatic amino acid biosynthesis draws its precursors from central carbon metabolism; when flux through central metabolism is not rebalanced toward those precursors, overexpressing terminal biosynthetic enzymes runs into a supply ceiling rather than a capacity ceiling. This precursor-supply constraint is mechanistically distinct from the trp operon's own feedback regulation.

engineering_hypothesis.hypothesis: Redistributing flux within central carbon metabolism to increase precursor (PEP/E4P) supply, analyzed before committing to terminal-enzyme overexpression, relieves the supply-side bottleneck limiting L-tryptophan titer.
engineering_hypothesis.expected_effect: improved precursor availability that enables higher pathway flux once combined with adequate terminal-enzyme expression
